body: The person can use the proposed setup in their own bedroom. Their OT can assess how it works for the transfers, positioning and daily routines that matter.

intro: You may know exactly what needs to improve at home, while the right bed and mattress are still undecided.
It might be a difficult transfer, repositioning overnight, or making enough room for a carer to help.
You can bring us the brief at that stage.
I’m David from Sleep Choice. We arrange seven-night therapeutic bed and mattress trials in the person’s home, working alongside their OT, family and care team.
